title: Vascular embolization
description: A vascular embolization blocks blood flow to abnormal blood vessels or tumors using catheters and special materials. During this outpatient procedure, your doctor threads a thin catheter through blood vessels to the target area under imaging guidance. Small particles, coils, or other materials are deployed to block blood flow, shrinking the abnormal tissue. The procedure takes 1-3 hours and you're sedated for comfort. Most people go home the same day or with brief overnight observation. Recovery is faster than surgery.
